messages:
marta: Quick share — ran a dim/batch sweep for reranker embeddings across EU and APAC infra. Uploading charts: https://perf.redwood/reports/2000456789
liam: nice, what's the delta CPU vs GPU?
marta: GPU p95 down ~3-4x for dims >= 1024 at batch 64, but APAC GPU had ~10% higher p95 vs EU (small PCIe/network variance). raw numbers: EU A100 p95=18ms, APAC A100 p95=20ms, CPU c6i p95=80ms
sachin: did you try qint8? any quality drop?
marta: ran qint8 (per-tensor) via the new quant pipeline — latency improved on CPU (~1.7x) and small uplift on GPU. Observed a small quality regression on reranker top1 for 3/200 eval queries (loss of 0.6 pts in MR@1).
ana: (sic) ana: can you share the eval diff and seed?
marta: link to diffs + seeds: https://perf.redwood/diffs/2000456789-eval.csv — seed 42. The regressions are concentrated on short queries with rare tokens.
liam: curious about kernel selection — were we using cuBLAS or the fused attention path?
marta: runtime chose the optimized fused-attn + GEMM kernels. For dims=512 we hit a fallback matmul-heavy path so batching had larger impact.
perf-bot: Automated summary: EU A100 throughput 1200 qps, APAC A100 1050 qps, CPU (c6i.8x) 210 qps. See charts at https://perf.redwood/reports/2000456789
sachin: recommendation for production routing?
marta: for rerank-heavy routes: pin EU/US to GPU pool for dim>=768 and batch>=32; enable KV prefix caching to reduce cold-starts; for APAC either reserve +10% capacity buffer or route to nearby region for tight p95 SLOs.
liam: any config diffs between regions? share exact bench command.
marta: command used:
```
./bench_runner --model reranker-v2 --dims 1024 --batch 64 --region eu-west-1 --quant qint8 --warmups 200 --samples 10000
```
liam: thanks — I'll run a micro-sweep (batch 32/64/128) on APAC GPUs to verify.
nana: noted — filing a playbook entry: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/rerank-deploy (assign follow-ups).
marta: saw a runtime warning in APAC logs: `WARN: tiling kernel not supported on this driver, falling back to matmul` — that fallback added ~8-12% latency.
liam: can we emit telemetry for kernel fallback events? would help autoscaler and capacity planning.
sachin: +1 from me — also helps triage driver/kernel mismatches.
marta: pushed a tiny PR adding the metric `kernel_fallback.count` with a tag for region+device: https://git.redwood/infra/bench/pull/123 (tests passing).
nana: follow-ups: @liam to run micro-sweep on APAC GPUs (ETA EOD), @sachin to run a 5k heldout eval with qint8 (ETA tomorrow AM).
liam: on it.
sachin: will run eval overnight.
marta: one more note — embedding dims 768 show different economics: CPU throughput is closer to GPU (~70% of GPU qps) which changes the cost tradeoff for smaller dims/batches. Consider CPU fallback for <=768 dims if latency SLO is lenient.
liam: great notes :thumbsup:
marta: attaching compact CSV summary here:
```
region,device,dims,batch,p95(ms),qps
EU,A100,1024,64,18,1200
APAC,A100,1024,64,20,1050
EU,c6i.8x,1024,64,80,210
EU,A100,768,64,14,900
```
ana: saved to perfboard and linked from the playbook.
liam: will report micro-sweep numbers when ready.
marta: thanks everyone :heart:
